messages:
lia (product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing q&a thread. Keeping this short 197 post questions here and we'll answer.
raj (sales): Do we surface a warning email before a large trial credit is consumed?
sam (finance): Yes, we send two emails: 25% and 10% remaining, plus an in-console banner. Customers can opt into daily digest instead.
matt (eng): On the API side we emit `X-Usage-Warning` when remaining credits cross thresholds so SDKs can hook into it.
kiana (ops): What about per-route quotas vs global account quotas? Some customers hit a single hot route.
matt (eng): We maintain both. Global quota stops total spend, route quotas protect hotspots. Route overrides can be requested for enterprise tenants.
raj (sales): If a customer has multiple projects under one org, are credits shared or siloed?
sam (finance): By default credits are org-level and shared. We offer project-level sub-billing for enterprise if they want siloing.
lia (product): Is there any automated throttling behavior when credits deplete mid-job?
matt (eng): We try to let in-flight tokens finish where reasonable, then throttle new requests. For long-running streaming calls we cut off at checkpoint boundaries.
billing-bot: Billing alert: "Trial credit 5% remaining for org acme-inc" sent to billing@acme.inc
raj (sales): Requests come from customers confused about "grace" vs "burst". Can you briefly define both?
kiana (ops): Burst = short-term extra capacity available via add-on or per-contract policy. Grace = short soft window to let traffic finish before hard-enforcing limits.
sam (finance): Also note bursts are billable; grace is not a charge, it's a short enforcement delay.
lia (product): Refunds: do we have a documented SLA for handling billing disputes?
sam (finance): We aim to respond within 3 business days, resolve within 10. Small one-offs often resolved same-day. Repeat refunds require account review.
raj (sales): Any rate-limit headers customers should rely on? We want predictable retry logic in SDKs.
matt (eng): Use `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` and `X-RateLimit-Route`. For 429s include `Retry-After`. SDKs should implement backoff + jitter.
lia (product): Are eval credits for private deployments handled differently?
sam (finance): If we issued evaluation credits for a POC those are tracked on the hosted account used for the POC. Private self-hosts do not consume hosted credits unless we manage the infra.
raj (sales): One last: can we proactively whitelist critical customer keys to avoid accidental throttling?
kiana (ops): We can create whitelist policies per-contract for emergency endpoints; requires ops review and capacity check.
lia (product): Great thread. If anyone needs a follow-up doc or a decision ticket, drop a +1 and I'll file a short RFC. :memo:
